scope: Rough comparative CAD/CFD study authorized using catalogue and image references. No additional lab measurements required to begin conceptual cases.
installed_hardware: Jeanoko 08, confirmed by user; EXAIR is a modeling reference, not the installed tube.

nozzle_reference.listed_connection: 3/8 NPT, intended for Milton S-181/S-182 guns
nozzle_reference.dimensional_limit: Listing includes package dimensions and inconsistent product dimensions; do not use these as individual nozzle length or bore.
nozzle_reference.internal_geometry: Not published in inspected listing. Simplified equivalents required.

source_reference.selected_surrogate: EXAIR 3208 / small tube family, reference only
source_reference.cad_access: Product page indicates login/model selection for CAD downloads. Public dimension drawing inspected; native CAD not obtained.
source_reference.adapter_required_in_reference_assembly: 1/4 NPT source cold port to Milton 3/8 NPT interface; connection details simplified, not a fabrication drawing.

study_approach: Represent measured-unknown cold source by prescribed cold mass flow and total temperature at a defined near-atmospheric cold-branch plane.
Do not apply 6.9 bar compressed-air inlet pressure at the cold delivery plane.
Build equivalent nozzle concepts, not exact internal replicas of Milton products.
Compare baseline round outlet, compact smooth outlet, rounded slot and short open shield.
Use matching cold mass flow and total temperature across geometry cases; separately examine required pressure drop.
Prescribed-flow downstream CFD cannot predict vortex backpressure response; assess that separately using reference limits or a source map.

provisional_scenarios.status: Design assumptions only; not measured source output or a fitted vortex performance map. Some combinations may not be achievable by installed hardware.
provisional_scenarios.geometry_status: Bores and internal passages are proposed parameters, not values derived from nominal pipe threads.
provisional_scenarios.capacity_note: Range follows assumed mass flow * 1005 * (ambient-total temperature), before target interception. Not a prediction from the seller rating.
provisional_scenarios.humidity_status: Dry-air screening first. Flag below-dew-point regions; moisture/condensation requires a later model if material to ranking.
provisional_scenarios.target_area: Keep a mapped target plane at 200 mm; choose and label any heated-patch area before heat-transfer ranking.

expected_outputs: Dimensioned parametric conceptual geometry and mesh-ready fluid surfaces
CFD case definitions for source and wind sensitivity
Temperature/velocity/source-fraction maps and pressure loss, only after a solver run
current_status: Four STEP/STL concepts and fluid meshes generated. CFD screening executed for one source condition and two wind conditions, with two refined-mesh spot checks. Numerical convergence remains a limit; see case audits.
